money.title: Money
money.currencyHint: Locked once a receipt exists — every figure is kept in this one currency, and receipts in another are converted into it.
money.limitHint: Optional. When set, spend is also shown as a percentage of it. Changing it affects presentation only — finalised months are never rewritten.
money.hint: Income entered for a month replaces the usual amount there. Months still run from the 1st.
money.balanceHint: Not your income: the money on your cards and accounts right now. From today it goes up with income and down with every purchase.
money.taxesHint: Income comes in before tax and you pay it yourself — sole trader, contract work.
money.taxRateHint: Your own rate, from each taxed income: PIT, flat tax, health contribution together. Gifts and things sold are not taxed unless you say so.
money.taxFixedHint: Paid once a month whatever came in — a social contribution, a lump-sum tax. Empty for none.

account.title: Account
account.sessionsHint: Signing out everywhere revokes every refresh token, including this one.
account.changeHint: We'll send a link to the new address. The account switches only once you follow it.
account.sent: Check {{email}}: follow the link there to finish the change.

forwarding.title: Receipts by email
forwarding.label: Your forwarding address
forwarding.hint: Forward a shop's e-receipt here from {{email}}. It is read like a photo and appears on Receipts marked as from email. Mail from any other address is ignored.
forwarding.replaceQuestion: The current address stops working at once. Replace it?

usage.title: Receipts this month
usage.unlimited: No limit on this account. {{used}} read so far this month.
usage.note: Each receipt read by photo or by email counts. The count starts again on {{date}}.

install.title: App
install.body: Budget Agent installs on this device and opens full screen, like any other app. No app store needed, and it always runs the latest version.
install.ios: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install.hintTitle: Put Budget Agent on your home screen
install.hintBody: It opens full screen like an app, straight to your receipts.
install.hintIos: Tap Share in Safari, then Add to Home Screen. It then opens full screen like an app.

accuracy.title: Reading accuracy
accuracy.empty: No receipts were read in the last 6 months, so there is nothing to measure yet.
accuracy.headline_one: {{corrected}} of {{count}} receipt read in the last 6 months needed a correction ({{share}}).
accuracy.headline_other: {{corrected}} of {{count}} receipts read in the last 6 months needed a correction ({{share}}).
accuracy.remembered_one: Your remembered corrections fixed {{count}} more line by themselves.
accuracy.remembered_other: Your remembered corrections fixed {{count}} more lines by themselves.

data.title: Your data
data.exportHint: One archive: your data as JSON and the receipt photos still kept. Photos are kept 90 days.
data.deleteHint: Removes your account, receipts, photos, trips, goals and everything else for good.
data.dialogBody: Everything goes: receipts and their photos, trips, goals, advice, categories, products and exports. You leave your household; if you own it, it passes to the member who joined first. This cannot be undone — download your data first if you may need it.

security.title: Sign-in security
security.label: Two-factor sign-in
security.hint: After your password, sign-in also asks for a code from an authenticator app on your phone.
security.adminNeedsIt: As an admin, you need it to open the admin pages.
security.step1: Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
security.step2: Scan this QR code with it.
security.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
security.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key by hand:
security.codesBody: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now: keep them somewhere safe.
security.offBody: Sign-in will ask only for your password again.
security.codeOrRecovery: Code from the app or a recovery code

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.darkAtNightHint: Midnight whenever your device is in dark mode.

work.title: Work trips
work.label: I travel for work
work.hint: Shows business trips: per diem and a settlement for your employer.

regular.title: Regular income
regular.hint: What comes every month, already as it reaches your account. It counts by itself; anything extra you add on top.
regular.name: What it is
regular.taxed: My tax comes out of it

bills.title: Regular bills
bills.hint: What goes every month without a receipt — rent, subscriptions, a loan. It counts by itself, before what you spend.
bills.name: What it is
